questions.question: Can I bring my kids?
answer_facts: Children are welcome at every villa except The Cashew House for children under 5 (open rooftop).

questions.question: Yo, can I take my dog to Casa Kokum or what?
answer_facts: Dogs are allowed at Casa Kokum and Villa Sol only, up to 2 dogs per booking, with a ₹1,500 per-stay cleaning fee.

questions.question: If I wanted to throw a birthday party with more than 4 friends, how would I go about that?
answer_facts: Events of any kind (birthdays, wedding functions, parties) with more than 4 visitors need written approval from a manager before booking.

questions.question: What are the rules for kids at the villas regarding supervision?
answer_facts: Children must be supervised around water at all times.
